preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of string P is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S are lowercase alphabets.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in P are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (1 <= len(output) <= len(S) and all(c in output for c in P))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a substring of S that contains all characters of P with the smallest length. If there are multiple such substrings of the same length, the one with the least starting index is returned.
